author: Dave Smith
title: Dark mode looks great on the new Mac software coming later this year - but what really needs a true dark mode is iOS (AAPL)
text: Dark mode looks great on the new Mac software coming later this year — but what really needs a true dark mode is iOS (AAPL) By Dave Smith Jun 6, 2018, 5:41 pm 21 pts This week, Apple announced the next version of the Mac operating system, macOS Mojave, will feature a system-wide "dark mode" for the first time. Developers and Apple fans love the new dark mode, but what really needs a true system-wide dark mode is iOS. This week, Apple finally gave Mac developers…
